baseline: B00: prior-only 250-observation high/low breakout with EWMA alpha=0.25
DM-20260924-10 BOX_RIDGE_001: annual expanding Ridge, 5 features, lambda=1.0

walk_forward_folds.role: Jan-Mar partial; report separately; previously seen Train

confirmation_policy.purpose: signal transmission and hypothesis identification diagnostics only

feature_definitions.box_duration: Largest L in {5,10,...,120} with prior-only High-Max minus Low-Min divided by prior ATR20 below 3; window ends at t-1.
feature_definitions.box_width_atr: Selected prior box width divided by prior ATR20; evaluate tightness as its negative rank.
feature_definitions.close_position: Prior close position inside the selected prior-only box.
feature_definitions.distance_to_prior_high: Prior close divided by high maximum over observations t-251 through t-2, minus one.
feature_definitions.breakout_volume_ratio_diagnostic: Raw Volume[t] in common share units divided by the prior 20-observation median, ending t-1; event-only univariate diagnostic, not a model feature.
feature_definitions.upper_touch_density_diagnostic: Among selected box observations ending t-1, share with High within 1% of that box's Upper; event-only univariate diagnostic, not a model feature.
feature_definitions.t_close_timing_diagnostics: One model-free comparison of existing t-1 box_duration/width/close_position versus the same fixed windows recomputed through t High/Low/Close; does not alter the fitted model or create extra ablation trials.
feature_definitions.event: Close[t] exceeds prior 250-observation High, with 250-row history available.
feature_definitions.matched_control: A = event and box_duration>0; B = same-date event set with box_duration=0; equal-weight daily means over dates with both groups.

model: Unchanged annual expanding Ridge (lambda=1.0) trained on mature prior high-breakout rows and daily centered full-cross-section target ranks; same five existing features. Reuse the fixed walk-forward predictions across all six score ablations. No new model feature or target horizon.

parameters.short_signal: preserve B00 score for all ablations

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive event-only prediction quality and score-to-weight-to-Net transmission; no candidate selection/adoption.
